The market reacted sharply to recent US-Iran conflict reports. Traders are now closely watching the upcoming US midterm elections, which could impact Congressional dominance. As economic conditions evolve, the demand for state-debt auctions remains a key focus, with investors showing caution amid global uncertainties.

articles.title: A response to Andy Burnham: We need an apology and reparations
articles.desc: It is good news the British PM is open to calls for an apology. But debt restructuring instead of reparations won’t do.

articles.title: India to make tunnel boring machines at home if China curbs exports: Piyush Goyal
articles.desc: India is gearing up to start producing its own tunnel boring machines if China decides to limit its exports. This statement came from Piyush Goyal, India's trade minister, after Beijing made its recent announcement. It highlights India’s plan to not rely on foreign supplies and enhance its domestic manufacturing capabilities in this crucial area.

articles.title: Saudi Aramco Q3 profit jumps 34.5% to $36.25 billion despite ongoing US-Iran conflict
articles.desc: Saudi Aramco reported a 34.5% year-on-year rise in third-quarter net profit to $36.25 billion, beating analyst estimates. Higher oil prices and the exit from a joint venture supported earnings, helping offset production disruptions and security risks amid the US-Iran conflict.

articles.title: No water to sow, no respite at the grocery store: India's prolonged food inflation worry
articles.desc: Indian farmers face challenges in sowing winter crops amid dwindling water supplies from a weak monsoon. Amarsingh Gushinge's village experiences a significant rainfall deficit, impacting crop planting decisions. Food inflation could worsen as key staples see rising prices, aggravating the economic strain on households. The Reserve Bank of India may respond with interest rate hikes to combat rising inflationary pressures.

articles.title: Uncertainty is certain: India is resilient and will emerge stronger
articles.desc: Despite global uncertainty, India remains well placed to weather economic and market disruptions, supported by resilient growth, deeper domestic capital markets and rising private investment. Stronger institutions, infrastructure spending and emerging industries could further reinforce the country’s long-term prospects.

articles.title: US tech giants' AI borrowing could push up Europe's bond yields
articles.desc: Rising AI infrastructure investments are driving US technology giants to tap European bond markets, potentially increasing borrowing costs. Alphabet, Meta, Amazon and Microsoft are expected to boost debt issuance, intensifying competition for investor capital and putting pressure on corporate credit spreads and European government bond yields.

articles.title: China to expand global access to yuan assets, promote Hong Kong as offshore hub
articles.desc: China plans to expand global access to yuan-denominated assets and strengthen Hong Kong's role as an offshore yuan hub. Meanwhile, regulators flagged risks from surging AI investments, warning of rising leverage, higher borrowing costs and financial instability.

articles.title: AST SpaceMobile Stock Crash: Why ASTS shares plunged 11% as SpaceX eyes Boost Mobile
articles.desc: AST SpaceMobile shares hit a 52-week low amid SpaceX's potential Boost Mobile deal, intensifying competition concerns. Delayed satellite launches, execution risks and shifting analyst ratings further weigh on investor sentiment.

articles.title: KRBL shares rally 9% after Q2 net profit jumps 51% YoY
articles.desc: KRBL shares jumped nearly 9% after the company reported a 51% rise in second-quarter profit, supported by strong domestic sales and improved operating performance. Revenue increased 14%, while EBITDA climbed sharply, reinforcing positive momentum in the stock.

articles.title: Only 3.2% of working Indians trade stocks. Why Morgan Stanley likes NSE
articles.desc: Morgan Stanley has initiated coverage of NSE with an overweight rating and a price target of Rs 2,315, citing its dominant market share, strong liquidity and India’s underpenetrated capital markets. The brokerage expects revenue and normalised profit to grow at 15% annually between FY27 and FY29. It sees long-term growth opportunities but flags regulatory changes and market-share losses as key risks.

articles.title: MCX gold prices fall Rs 1,400/10 gram, silver tanks Rs 4,300/kg ahead of Diwali while rate hike bets linger. What should you do?
articles.desc: Gold and silver prices declined on MCX as rising oil prices and renewed inflation concerns weighed on bullion sentiment. Investors tracked US midterm elections and Fed rate expectations, while experts flagged key trading levels amid continued volatility in precious metals.

articles.title: Record-breaking FII selling may have peaked, says Nomura. Why the Nifty target could rise
articles.desc: FIIs may be nearing the end of their record selling spree in Indian equities as outflows ease, earnings beat expectations and valuations fall below post-pandemic averages, according to Nomura. Foreign investors sold around $8.8 billion since September 15, although the pace has moderated. Meanwhile, companies in Nomura’s BSE 200+ universe reported 34% year-on-year profit growth, beating consensus estimates by 18%.

articles.title: US midterm elections today: Can Trump’s pain be Dalal Street’s gain? Analysts estimate impact in 3 possible scenarios
articles.desc: The United States will hold crucial midterm elections that could significantly alter the balance of power in Congress. Analysts are focusing on potential scenarios that could emerge based on whether the Democrats or Republicans hold the majority. These outcomes may impact critical issues such as tariffs, immigration, foreign relations, and even oil prices.

articles.title: Global markets were already fragile. Big AI bets could break them
articles.desc: Investors flocked to bonds. Yields, which move inversely to price, fell from multidecade highs, with the benchmark 10-year Treasury, which guides borrowing costs globally, falling almost 20 basis points on October 22, its biggest daily fall since early 2023.

articles.title: Trident shares rally 13% after Q2 net profit jumps 93% to Rs 175 crore; firm plans Rs 4,650 crore capex
articles.desc: Trident shares rallied 13% after the company reported a 93.1% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 175.50 crore. Improved EBITDA and margins supported earnings growth, while the company announced a Rs 4,650-crore capacity expansion and modernisation programme.

articles.title: Diwali stocks by Motilal Oswal: Eternal, Adani Ports among 10 stocks with upside of up to 40%. See full list
articles.desc: Motilal Oswal has identified ten stocks poised for remarkable growth in the market landscape. Anticipated leaders like Kotak Mahindra Bank and Titan are forecasted to achieve significant earnings boosts. Projections for FY27 suggest a revival of double-digit growth across various sectors. Notably, Adani Ports and Eternal stand out among the select recommendations, urging investors to consider these stocks for their portfolios.

articles.title: Anthropic IPO: What its latest financial filing reveals about AI growth

articles.title: Coal India said to plan $1 billion MCL IPO as soon as this month
articles.desc: Coal India is preparing a $1 billion IPO of its subsidiary Mahanadi Coalfields, potentially launching in late November or early December 2026. The offer will involve a 10% stake sale by the parent, valuing MCL at up to $10 billion. MCL contributed 22.4% of India's non-coking coal production in FY26.

articles.title: Reddit blasts Australia's 'inept' social media ban as court challenge begins
articles.desc: Australia's world-first teen social media ban was "ill thought out" and amounted to a "profound restriction on political debate", a lawyer for messaging platform Reddit told the country's top court in the first legal challenge to the law.

articles.title: Smallcap stocks to buy this Diwali! 5 stocks with upside potential of up to 37%. Do you own any?
articles.desc: As Diwali approaches, Mirae Asset Sharekhan highlights five promising smallcap stocks with potential for significant growth. DEE Development targets Rs 750, suggesting a possible 37% increase. Similarly, Karnataka Bank is set at Rs 415, indicating a 33% rise. Additionally, Lumax Auto Technologies and VA Tech Wabag offer targets of Rs 2,490 and Rs 2,400 respectively, making them appealing options for investors eyeing gains based on robust fundamentals.

articles.title: Israeli forces kill four in Gaza as fifth Palestinian dies of wounds
articles.desc: Nearly 1,600 Palestinians have been killed in Gaza since a US-brokered 'ceasefire' took effect in October last year.

articles.title: LTCG abolition may cost just Rs 40,000–50,000 crore, SBI estimates show
articles.desc: SBI Research estimates that abolishing long-term capital gains (LTCG) tax would cost the government just Rs 40,000–50,000 crore in FY27, far below the Rs 1.3 lakh crore collected in FY25. Weaker stock market returns and sustained foreign investor outflows have significantly reduced expected collections, suggesting the move may not derail the government's fiscal consolidation plans.

articles.title: Beyond tech: Kotak MF’s Shibani Kurian on India’s next innovation-led winners
articles.desc: Innovation-led investment opportunities in India are extending well beyond technology, with healthcare, auto components and industrials emerging as key areas of interest, according to Shibani Kurian, Head of Equity Research and Senior Fund Manager at Kotak Mahindra AMC. “Innovation can be seen across sectors and not necessarily limited to technology,” she said.

articles.title: ideaForge shares jump 7% as firm swings to profit in Q2, revenue soars 124% YoY

articles.title: IndiGo, Indian Oil and other crude-sensitive stocks rally up to 4% as oil dips below $105/bbl. Where are prices headed?

articles.title: Chinese yuan set for biggest daily drop in six months after PBOC tightens FX reserves
articles.desc: China's yuan weakened against the US dollar after the PBOC raised the foreign exchange reserve requirement ratio to curb rapid currency appreciation. The move comes amid concerns over export competitiveness and follows strong gains in the yuan during October.

articles.title: Why is market rising today? Sensex jumps over 1,000 pts, Nifty above 23,700. 6 key factors behind today's rally

This surge was primarily driven by declining oil prices and favorable sentiments around the long-term capital gains tax. Enthusiasm among investors surged, particularly following significant net buying from foreign institutional investors. Though sectors such as Nifty Auto and Financial Services rallied, Nifty Pharma lagged behind.

articles.title: $64 billion out, $5 billion in? Why LTCG tax cut may not be enough to bring FIIs back
articles.desc: A reassessment of long-term capital gains tax is underway as foreign investors continue their significant selloff from Indian equities. Analysts at JM Financial project that tax relief may yield only $3–5 billion in fresh inflows. This minimal increase may not be sufficient to reverse the current trend of investor exodus amidst concerns over oil prices. India’s tax regime differentiates between dollar and rupee gains, impacting foreign investor returns significantly.

articles.title: Apple Q4 results beat estimates as iPhone 18 Pro demand, price hikes offset rising chip costs

The dollar index recorded a slight increase, reflecting cautious investor sentiment amid upcoming midterm elections in the US. In the domestic equity market, the Sensex and Nifty both experienced significant gains.

articles.desc: Speaking on the sidelines of ET Wealth Expo 2026 in Mumbai, Mohan identified intergenerational wealth transfer as one of the major socio-cultural mega trends unfolding in India. NBCC among 5 stocks showing White Marubozu Pattern
articles.desc: The pattern is represented by a long white (or green) candlestick with no upper shadow and little or no lower shadow. It reflects strong upward price movement during the session, with the price moving from the opening level toward the session high by the close. The pattern is commonly studied in technical analysis as an indicator of price momentum.

articles.title: Wiscon Industries SME shares to list today: Check subscription status and key detail
articles.desc: Wiscon Industries will debut on the BSE SME platform on November 3, 2026, following its Rs 110-crore IPO, subscribed 88% overall. Its revenue surged to Rs 73.39 crore in FY26, reflecting rapid business growth.

articles.desc: Renowned economist Jeffrey D Sachs said India could become the world’s largest economy by the end of the century, with a population twice that of China. Speaking at the World Symposium on "Ancient Wisdom for Modern Challenges" in Varanasi, he said the world was moving towards a multipolar order where no single country or region would dominate.

This review involves input from respective line ministries and industry stakeholders regarding these exemptions. Goods under review include materials for power projects and certain medical devices. articles.desc: The rules establish a multi-tier grievance redressal mechanism at the gram panchayat, block and district levels. articles.desc: The Centre is planning to restructure the minimum support price mechanism for minor forest produce. This change aims to provide periodic hikes to benefit tribal communities relying on forest produce. TERI has been tasked to study the current MSP framework and assess potential rationalization. Concerns regarding stagnant MSP rates sparking exploitation among forest-dependent communities have been raised in parliamentary discussions.

articles.title: Pakistan suffered $40 billion in economic losses due to suspension of trade with India: PIBC chief
articles.desc: Lahore has faced an estimated USD 40 billion in economic losses since trade with India paused in 2019. Business leaders emphasize the need for restoring these commercial ties to stimulate mutual benefits. The suspension has escalated costs for essential goods that are typically imported from India. Industries, particularly textiles and pharmaceuticals, have struggled to cope with rising transportation and sourcing expenses.

articles.title: India's economic pillars show 'no fragility', says Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman
articles.desc: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman highlighted the government's commitment to increasing capital expenditure to promote economic growth. She remarked on the importance of fiscal prudence while implementing spending strategies effectively. Sitharaman emphasized the need for public investment to enhance welfare programs and improve access to essential services. The government aims to provide comprehensive insurance coverage by 2047 to foster financial inclusion.

articles.title: Capex key to India's growth strategy, fiscal prudence remains top priority: Sitharaman at HSBC event
articles.desc: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman highlighted the importance of capital expenditure in driving economic growth in India. She stated that government spending would be guided by fiscal discipline while encouraging private sector investment. Sitharaman noted that higher public investment has historically generated strong economic returns over time. She reassured that the Indian economy remains robust, with no sign of fragility.

articles.title: Indians turn to side hustles, freelancing as non-salary income rises: ClearTax
articles.desc: Indians are increasingly earning from non-salary sources like trading and freelancing as reported by ClearTax. The percentage of self-filers reporting such income grew significantly from previous years. Data shows that young individuals are entering investment opportunities earlier than ever before. Additionally, women's participation in capital gains and higher income brackets has increased noticeably. This reflects a significant change in financial habits and diversification of income sources among taxpayers.

articles.title: Keralam aims to bring in special Act to protect women from social media attacks
articles.desc: "The government is thinking of sending those who attack women on social media to prison by bringing in a special Act," CM V D Satheesan said while inaugurating 'Makalkoppam', a two-day seminar organised by the Women and Child Development Department to formulate a women's policy after discussions with various stakeholders.

articles.title: India’s manufacturing output dominated by large factories, while smaller units lag behind
articles.desc: India's manufacturing sector is highly fragmented, with large factories significantly outpacing small units in productivity and output. While large establishments employ most industrial workers and generate high GVA, smaller units remain burdened with debt. The productivity gap is exacerbated by limited access to technology and training for smaller factories. Additionally, women workers constitute a small fraction of the overall workforce in manufacturing.
